info.name: TaskForge API
info.description: Project & task management backend (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL). Base URL: http://localhost:4040. All `/api/v1/*` routes except `/health` require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (obtained from `/auth/login` or `/auth/register`). The refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie called `tf_refresh` and is sent automatically by browsers.

request.description:
Returns the overall service status. Pings the database (timeout 2s).

- `200` when `status` is `operational` or `degraded`
- `503` when `status` is `down` (DB unreachable)

Public; no auth, no throttling.

response.name: 200 operational
200 degraded (DB slow)

request.description:
Same probe as `/health` but also returns the individual checks. Suitable for k8s readiness probes.

- `200` when `checks.database === 'up'`
- `503` when `checks.database === 'down'`

response.name: 200 OK
503 down

request.description:
Creates an account and starts a session. Sets the `tf_refresh` httpOnly cookie. Rate limited: 10/min/IP.

**Body**
| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | 2–80 chars, trimmed |
| `email` | string | valid email, lowercased |
| `password` | string | 8–128 chars, must contain a letter and a digit |

**Errors**: `409 EMAIL_TAKEN`.

response.name: 201 Created

header.value: tf_refresh=<opaque>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=...

response.name: 409 EMAIL_TAKEN
response.body:
{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "error": "Conflict",
  "message": "An account with this email already exists.",
  "code": "EMAIL_TAKEN",
  "details": [{ "field": "email", "message": "Already in use." }]
}

request.description:
Signs in with email + password, sets the refresh cookie, and returns the user + access token. Demo accounts use `Demo1234!`. Rate limited: 10/min/IP.

**Errors**: `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.

response.name: 200 OK
401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
response.body:
{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized",
  "message": "Incorrect email or password.",
  "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
  "details": []
}

request.description:
Rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new access token. Reads the cookie (set by `/auth/login` or `/auth/register`). Public route.

**Errors**: `401 REFRESH_INVALID` (missing, expired or revoked token).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Revokes the presented refresh token and clears the cookie. Always returns 204. Public route.
Returns the signed-in user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Updates name, email and/or avatar. All fields optional. Pass `null` for `avatar` to remove it.

**Body**
| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string? | 2–80 chars |
| `email` | string? | valid email |
| `avatar` | string? \| null | URL, ≤2048 chars, or null |

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Anonymises the account (renames to "Deleted user", randomises email/password, drops owned projects and memberships, unassigns tasks). Refused with `422 OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE` while the user owns any project that still has other members.

**Errors**: `422 OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE`.
Changes the password. Requires the current password.
Always returns 204 whether the email exists or not. The reset link is written to the server log (`origin/reset-password?token=...`). Rate limited: 10/min/IP.
Consumes the reset token from `/auth/forgot-password`. Revokes all refresh tokens for the user. Rate limited: 10/min/IP.
